mechanisms: Fovea live MJPEG latest-only single encoded slot
scope.ordering: four latest-first and four decode-every-first trials inside each independent process block
scope.correctnessOracle: exact final source index 119 and exact final pixel digest equality
scope.ingestionFence: inputFinished, pendingPartIndex 119 and droppedEncodedFrameCount 118 before first decode release

directionalTiming.interpretation: In this synthetic overload mechanism, bounded latest-only work completed with roughly four percent of the decode-every elapsed time at the median while decoding 2/120 frames. This is not a codec, network, player or product comparison.

methodologyCorrection.rejectedObservation: The unfenced first run decoded two to four frames across eight trials because ingestion had not converged before the first decode was released.
methodologyCorrection.acceptedCorrection: Fence exact ingestion state before release and fail validation unless all 48 trials decode exactly two frames.

reasons: The Fovea source tree is dirty and the evidence binds an uncommitted local binary.
The decode body is synthetic SHA-256 CPU work rather than ImageIO JPEG decode throughput.
The decode-every baseline intentionally queues the full burst and is not memory-equivalent to the single-slot policy.
No URLSession, display deadline, energy, thermal, memory-pressure tail or physical-device endpoint was measured.
No performance threshold or overall product ranking was preregistered.
